plainText:
Megan Hollingshead is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is also credited as Karen Thompson and Kelli Kassidi.

== Biography ==
Hollingshead was born on September 22, 1968. She was one of the original voice actresses on . She worked on the show until the end of the sixth season, when she left the show and moved to Los Angeles, California, to continue building her voice-over career. Her most prominent roles were Nurse Joy and Cassidy, which were taken over by Bella Hudson and Andi Whaley, respectively. Hollingshead currently resides in Nashville, Tennesse with her family. Hollingshead is currently affiliated with AVO Talent Agency.

Hollingshead returned to the at the start of , most prominently reprising the role of Nurse Joy.
